title: Support containerd Runtime v2 (aka shim v2)
body:
### Feature request description

Runtime v2 introduces a first class shim API for runtime authors to integrate with containerd. With Runtime v2 support, Podman can use `containerd-shim-kata-v2` as a runtime, enabling integration with Kata Containers.

FYI: 
https://containerd.io/docs/main/runtime-v2/
https://github.com/kata-containers/kata-containers/issues/722

comments.body:
We have no interest in adding the entire kata runtime API interface into our codebase.

https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/8579
https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/17070

If someone wants to run micro VMs we do have "krun" support now which uses libkrun via crun.
